note: Every number is an assumption with no human data behind it (SAP v1 section 9). v3 (2026-11-19, task C1 of the roadmap) keeps the v2 targets, models, seed and CI method and adds: cuff noise SD sigma_cuff in noise_levels (unsourced; v2 used only the first level); tau_day is held fixed, so the levels above the first are incompatible with the S4 resting median |dSBP| of about 3 mmHg under the two-cuff BP0 of the SAP (summary prints the implied median); an optional M6 cuff per evaluation session with invented subject-level responses (Koba 2004 does not give seated cuff values), tracked either with the same slope b or with no PAT gain at M6; an optional best-case repeat of the M1, M2 and M6 cuffs (two cuffs averaged, error correlation rho, no drift, predictions not averaged). Adding M6 changes the estimand (M0 weight 2/4 -> 2/5); d over M0-M2 is reported apart. Model errors do not change with cuff noise, so only the evaluation labels get noisier. SBP and DBP are simulated apart (no Holm step).

decision_rules.written: 2026-11-19, before any v3 output was produced
decision_rules.R1_precision: At the planned design, reference noise, M2 moderate, no M6, no repeat, model 'null': the share of studies whose 97.5 % CI of mean d_s lies within +-fixed_delta (reading 'equivalent') is at least 0.80, for SBP and DBP. Checked with the decision_check draws.
decision_rules.R2_alarm: Same setting, model 'strong': P(main conclusion) at 97.5 % below 0.50 is an alarm reported to the team, not a pass/fail criterion; it depends on the invented model scenario.
decision_rules.R3_action: If R1 fails: report which of repeat, M6 (with and without PAT gain at M6) or both restore R1, with their cost in session time; the choice among them is made by the team (C2, M6 criteria), never because an option makes the main conclusion more likely.
decision_rules.R4_delta: Readings are reported at the SAP rule delta for each noise level and at fixed_delta. Whether to cap delta is decided by the team from the R1/R2 tables before the SAP is locked; no cap is applied in this run.
